claims: Kelly is the youngest child of Hal and Lois in the Malcolm in the Middle reboot Life's Still Unfair (2026).
Kelly is played by nonbinary actor Vaughan Murrae.
Kelly is a self-sufficient studious teenager.
Kelly shares traits with their older brothers.
Kelly maintains a rivalry with Reese.
Kelly stems from the pregnancy reveal in the original 2006 series finale.
Kelly is wiser than most of their family.
Kelly is capable of being a trickster.
Kelly often acts as the good or favorite child.
Kelly plays tricks to get back at siblings.
Kelly engages in a heated rivalry with Reese.
Kelly was born to Hal and Lois years after the original series ended.
Kelly's background follows the pregnancy revealed in the 2006 finale.
